cells.gaps: No figure from checking a register against the ID is given: the 1,628,587 NINs validated for the social register (NGA-007) are a count of checks, not of records removed or corrected. No count of tax records keyed on the NIN is given.
cells.note: The social register (NGA-006, NGA-007) and online voter registration (NGA-010) use the NIN, and the tax service is among 125 agencies linked to it (NGA-016) with the NIN the individual tax number since January 2026 (NGA-013, NGA-008): three main registers, stage 4. Stage 5 needs a matching figure.
